actionCalls.description: Queues a refresh for one decision table. refreshDecisionTable is NOT invocable from Apex ("refreshDecisionTable isn't a valid action type"), which is the entire reason this flow exists: Apex can start an autolaunched flow, and the flow can call the action. A table whose refresh throws must not abandon the tables after it, so the fault path counts the failure and returns to the loop.
actionCalls.name: Refresh_One_Table
actionCalls.label: Refresh One Table

assignments.description: Counts a table whose refresh threw, and records its API name so the caller can report exactly which ones failed rather than only how many.
assignments.name: Count_Failed
assignments.label: Count Failed

assignments.description: Counts a table successfully queued. Queued means accepted for refresh, not refreshed — the caller must still poll DecisionTable.RefreshStatus.
assignments.name: Count_Refreshed
assignments.label: Count Refreshed

Flow.description: Queues a refresh for every decision table API name passed in, optionally incremental. Exists because refreshDecisionTable cannot be called from Apex; RLM_DecisionTableManagerController starts this flow once with the whole selection, so a 40-table refresh is one interview rather than 40. Returns queuedCount, failedCount and failedApiNames. queuedCount counts tables ACCEPTED for refresh — poll DecisionTable.RefreshStatus to learn whether they completed. Note an incremental refresh advances LastIncrementalSyncDate only; LastSyncDate does not move.
Flow.label: RLM Refresh Decision Tables Bulk

variables.description: Decision table API names to refresh. An empty collection is a no-op returning zero counts, which the caller must distinguish from a successful refresh.
variables.name: decisionTableApiNames

variables.description: API names whose refresh threw, so the caller can name them instead of only counting them.
variables.name: failedApiNames

variables.description: Number of tables whose refresh threw.
variables.name: failedCount

variables.description: True for an incremental refresh. Defaults false. Requires an initial full refresh, and fails if more than 2000 records changed.
variables.name: isIncremental

variables.description: Number of tables accepted for refresh. Not a completion count.
variables.name: queuedCount
